data.description: Keystone: CNT-13 (w1) directly, but it is the only door to the organizer half of CNT-04 (w2), CNT-05 (w2), CNT-14 (w2) — ~23% of the area on one screen — PLUS the CNT-02 (w3) rescue (the portal never shows an uploaded filename; after upload the speaker sees a checkmark and no evidence of what they uploaded). NO MIGRATION: every presign already mints a new attachment row (unique r2_key), old rows persist, speaker_tasks.attachment_id is the latest-pointer. (1) src/lib/files/versions.ts: listVersionsFor(db, ownerType, ownerId) with ROW_NUMBER version numbers and is_latest DERIVED as attachments.id = speaker_tasks.attachment_id — derive, never store. (2) FileVersions component mounted in the portal task row ('slides.pdf - v2 of 2 - uploaded ...' + prior versions each downloadable) and in the library. Export both — the speaker-files ticket consumes them. (3) /files route, sidebar label EXACTLY 'Files' (the spec enumerates the agent's guesses). GET .../files: attachments->speaker_tasks->submissions/people; filename, session, speaker, uploaded, version count, size; row expands to versions. 'Copy link' per row over existing publicMediaUrl with the honest caveat (unauthenticated capability URL). (4) Skip the per-session Files tab (rubric forgives). Human lens: list EXPECTED deliverables too — one row per speaker x file-task, filled or empty, chaseable — the screen an AV lead runs the show from. Full spec: section T-F1. Register rows 26,28 + CNT-02 rescue.

data.body:
MRQ-115 complete — PR #74 open and MERGEABLE at c26da34. https://github.com/Stage-11-Agentics/marquee/pull/74

Rebased onto github/main (fd977f1) after main moved 4 commits. Two conflicts:
  - src/ui/shell/AppShell.tsx — kept BOTH sides (main's SessionizeImportPage navigate prop + my files route line).
  - cli/api-registry.json — generated, so regenerated via node cli/generate-api-registry.mjs rather than hand-resolved; SKILL.md regenerated with it.

LOCAL GATE (post-rebase, load 22):
  {"command":"pr-gate","ticket":"MRQ-115","status":"pass","elapsedMs":84639,"budgetMs":120000}
GitHub fast-gate: pass (2m47s).

Rubric: CNT-13 (w1) direct; CNT-04 (w2) both halves; CNT-02 (w3) rescue; opens the organizer door for CNT-05 (MRQ-116) and CNT-14 (MRQ-117).

Shipped: src/lib/files/versions.ts (listVersionsFor / listVersionsForOwners; is_latest DERIVED from the owner pointer, never stored; ready-only rows are versions); FileVersions component on both sides of the conference; /files with sidebar label exactly "Files" + GET /api/v1/events/{eventId}/files + a real "marquee files list" CLI verb; the portal task row now NAMES the uploaded file in the collapsed row. No migration — the versioning was already in storage.

Validated against a running Worker, not just green tests: two real uploads through sign -> PUT -> complete -> task complete; portal reads v2 of 2 / latest_source pointer; library reads slides.pdf, 2 versions, latest flagged, v1 separately downloadable; two abandoned presigns against the same task stay invisible (count is 2, not 4); 401/403/200 auth; 153 rows in 28-58ms. Browser pass completed on both surfaces after finding the WKWebView Secure-cookie condition already documented at src/lib/cookies.ts:17 (pre-existing, affects every authenticated screen; INSECURE_LOCAL_COOKIES=1 is the shipped opt-out). It caught one real defect no test would have: a subject-verb agreement error in the library header, fixed.

REVIEW FALLBACK, flagged per COMMON: the auto-fired single headless reviewer TIMED OUT at 600s under fleet load (1-min load 58, 5-min 134). Reviewed by delegator self-review instead, adversarially and at branch HEAD. Verdict PASS. Artifact art_01KZTG9Q02HGVQ1322WAVN15SY is labelled as self-review so it can be weighed accordingly — a second pair of eyes on this one would not be wasted.

Two things for whoever touches this next:
  1. tests/unit/route-table.test.ts asserts the ORDERED sidebar label list. Adding a sidebar row requires editing it — that is the test's purpose, not an obstacle.
  2. A new versioned route must join two contracts or the gate catches it late: cli/api-registry.json (regenerate) and the D1 placeholder inventory in tests/node/bulk-paths.AC-66-69.test.mjs (classify).

Also worth knowing: an external rebase was started and aborted inside my worktree mid-run, and a merge commit on my branch was replaced by my force-push. Nothing was lost (reflog clean, tree verified), but two actors were operating on this branch at once.

Status: pr_open. Merge Warden merges; I do not.

Board reconciliation 2026-08-12: verified DONE. PR #74 (mrq-115-files-library) merged 2026-08-12T08:25:16Z; merge commit b526d5d5 confirmed an ancestor of github/main via 'git merge-base --is-ancestor'. Ticket had drifted at pr_open. The repo has zero open and zero closed-unmerged PRs, so nothing is waiting on review. Status corrected to reflect merge, not PR-open.
